newsitem.title: FRANCE: French budget deficit 208.8 bln Ffr in April.
newsitem.headline: French budget deficit 208.8 bln Ffr in April.

text.p: France's budget deficit stood at 208.8 billion francs at the end of April compared to 222.8 billion at the end of April 1996, the finance ministry said on Monday.
Net budget receipts were 425.7 billion francs at the end of April, a 4.2 billion franc or one percent increase from the same time in 1996, the ministry said.
Expenditures were 577.7 billion francs compared to 579.5 billion francs at end April 1996, a decrease of 0.3 percent, the ministry added.
